form.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
responsibilities: Define and implement the Bank’s Information & Cyber Security strategy aligned with business objectives, risk appetite, and regulatory expectations.
Establish strong security governance, policies, standards, and operating models across the enterprise.
Provide regular reporting to the Board, MD, and senior leadership on cyber risk posture, incidents, and strategic initiatives.
Act as the single point of accountability for information security across the Bank.
Ensure compliance with RBI, CERT-In, SWIFT CSP, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, BCMS, DPDP Act, and other applicable regulations.
Lead enterprise cyber risk assessments, maturity assessments, and threat modeling.
Own third-party and supply-chain cyber risk management programs.
Drive audits, regulatory inspections, and supervisory engagements.
Provide security architecture oversight for core banking systems, digital banking platforms, cloud environments, APIs, and fintech integrations.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (Master’s preferred).
12–18+ years of progressive experience in Information & Cyber Security, with significant leadership experience in BFSI.
Proven experience as CISO / Deputy CISO / Head of Information Security in Banking, Financial Services, or Payments.
Strong hands-on and strategic knowledge of banking technologies and digital ecosystems.
CISO, CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/ Auditor

source_preview:
Job Description – Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
(Banking & Financial Services Industry)

Position Title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
Industry: Banking & Financial Services
Reports To: Managing Director / CEO / Board / CRO
Location: Andheri, Mumbai

Role Purpose:
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is a senior executive responsible for
establishing, executing, and overseeing the enterprise-wide information and cyber security
strategy for the Bank. The role ensures protection of customer data, digital assets, and
critical infrastructure while enabling secure business growth and regulatory compliance.
The CISO acts as the principal security advisor to the Board and executive leadership.

Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Leadership & Governance:
• Define and implement the Bank’s Information & Cyber Security strategy aligned with
business objectives, risk appetite, and regulatory expectations.
• Establish strong security governance, policies, standards, and operating models across the
enterprise.
• Provide regular reporting to the Board, MD, and senior leadership on cyber risk posture,
incidents, and strategic initiatives.
• Act as the single point of accountability for information security across the Bank.
Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management:
• Ensure compliance with RBI, CERT-In, SWIFT CSP, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, BCMS, DPDP Act,
and other applicable regulations.
• Lead enterprise cyber risk assessments, maturity assessments, and threat modeling.
• Own third-party and supply-chain cyber risk management programs.
• Drive audits, regulatory inspections, and supervisory engagements.
Security Architecture & Engineering:
• Provide security architecture oversight for core banking systems, digital banking
platforms, cloud environments, APIs, and fintech integrations.
• Review and approve security design for IT and digital transformation initiatives.

• Oversee implementation and optimization of security technologies including IAM, PAM,
SIEM/SOC, EDR, DLP, WAF, PKI, and Cloud Security controls.
Security Operations & Incident Response:
• Lead Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, and cyber crisis management.
• Ensure proactive threat detection, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and red
teaming.
• Lead response to major cyber incidents, ensuring timely containment, remediation, and
regulatory communication.
Data Security & Privacy:
• Define and execute enterprise-wide data security and privacy strategy.
